top_story.title: S&P 500 Hits Record Despite Iran Cease-Fire Concerns. Oil and Tech Stocks Rally.
top_story.summary: The phrase, emerging from Southeast Asia, is the best way to describe the market action on Monday.  The S&P 500 rose 0.2% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq was up 0.1%.  Investors had seen the S&P 500 and Nasdaq finish at a record last week as well.
